question.text: Oxidation state of sulphur in anions $\mathrm{SO}_3^{2-}, \mathrm{S}_2 \mathrm{O}_4^{2-}$ and $\mathrm{S}_2 \mathrm{O}_6^{2-}$ increases in the orders :

solution.text:
$\mathrm{In} \mathrm{SO}_3^{--}$
$$
\begin{aligned}
& x+3(-2)=-2 ; x=+4 \\
& \text { In } \mathrm{S}_2 \mathrm{O}_4^{--} \\
& 2 x+4(-2)=-2 \\
& 2 x-8=-2 \\
& 2 x=6 ; \quad x=+3 \\
& \text { In } \mathrm{S}_2 \mathrm{O}_6^{2-} \\
& 2 x+6(-2)=-2 \\
& 2 x=10 ; \quad x=+5
\end{aligned}
$$
hence the correct order is
$$
\mathrm{S}_2 \mathrm{O}_4{ }^{--} < \mathrm{SO}_3^{--} < \mathrm{S}_2 \mathrm{O}_6{ }^{--}
$$
